boundary: The names are statements about literal PGSp(4,3)-sets and local actions, not physical phase or particle identifications.

1620_common_line_cycle.common_line_action: one 4-cycle on the four common lines
1620_common_line_cycle.interpretation: a four-line spread pair plus one of the six cyclic orders of its four common lines

270_half_turn.interpretation: the undecorated four-line spread pair carries its canonical linewise half-turn

540_linewise_quarter_turn.interpretation: a four-line spread pair plus one of two inverse coherent quarter-turns on the four common lines

theorem: The order-4 size-540 and size-1620 classes are two natural decoration bundles over the 270 four-line spread pairs. The size-540 class chooses one of two inverse coherent linewise quarter-turns; the size-1620 class chooses one of six cyclic orders of the four common lines. Their stabilizers have orders 96 and 32, exactly the corresponding decoration stabilizers inside S4 x D8.
